Title: Azure Database Migration Service: PostgreSQL to Azure DB for PostgreSQL migrations support

Body.Content:
Now available in preview, the Azure Database Migration Service (DMS) provides users the ability to migrate on-premises PostgreSQL databases or PostgreSQL databases running in a virtual machine to Azure Database for PostgreSQL while the source database remains online during migration. To learn more about using DMS to perform online migrations with minimal downtime, see the article Migrate PostgreSQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

​Read the article Migrate PostgreSQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL
